name: Anthropic minimal wordmark social card by anthropic.com
description: A radically restrained 1200×630 social card: a warm paper off-white field carries nothing but the brand wordmark, set in bold letter-spaced uppercase and centered as a single focal point. The only gesture is the wordmark's own backslash detail, which doubles as visual interest; all hierarchy comes from scale and negative space. Colour is reduced to one near-black on one warm ivory, making the card read instantly at thumbnail size in a feed.
